name: adhd-unslop
description: i-have-adhd and unslop in one skill with a defined tie-breaker: ADHD shape wins in direct replies, unslop wins everywhere else.

interface.shortDescription: ADHD-friendly replies, unslopped writing, one tie-breaker
interface.longDescription: Combines the i-have-adhd and unslop skills. Both rule sets stay active. On a conflict, i-have-adhd wins in a direct reply to the user and unslop wins in any other writing.
